title: Mis B' Haven Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Pretty in Pink! Mis B’Haven is tucked away on the secret gem in Seaside called Rosewalk. Rosewalk in Seaside is a cluster of quaint cottages with a pedestrian footpath meandering through a thick grove of oaks trees on the East side directly across from Tupelo Pavilion.
description_expanded: Description119 ROSEWALK ALLEY1 KING, 1 DOUBLE, 1 TWINPretty in Pink in the Heart of SeasideExperience Seaside “pretty in pink” at Mis B’ Haven, a charming cottage tucked within the hidden enclave of Rosewalk—one of the town’s best-kept secrets. Nestled along a peaceful, oak-lined path on the East side, directly across from the beloved Tupelo Pavilion, this serene setting feels worlds away while still being just a one-minute stroll to the beach and a quick four-minute walk to the lively Seaside Amphitheater. Perfect for young families, Rosewalk offers a storybook escape where shaded sand paths wind beneath towering oaks—inviting both play and relaxation.A Hidden Garden Setting Made for Slow MorningsArrive to an inviting open-air front porch where a charming bistro dining setup for two and classic rocking chairs overlook the quaint Rosewalk Park. This peaceful perch is ideal for morning coffee or evening nightcaps, offering a front-row seat to the simple rhythms of Seaside life. Just beyond, the shaded grove, climbing trees, and soft sand paths create a natural playground—perfect for unwinding after sun-soaked beach days.Bright, Open Living with Coastal ComfortInside, the cottage welcomes you with a bright, thoughtfully updated living space where the kitchen, dining, and living areas flow seamlessly together. The fully renovated kitchen features modern appliances, custom cabinetry, and ample space to prepare everything from casual breakfasts to coastal-inspired dinners. Built-in shelving adds both charm and functionality, enhancing the relaxed yet refined feel of the home.Gather, Dine, and UnwindThe adjoining living room is designed for comfort, featuring a plush cloud-style sofa, two cozy club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV—perfect for relaxed evenings in. A custom-built dining nook with a round table, bench seating, and additional chairs creates an intimate space for family meals, morning planning sessions, or late-night games.Flexible Sleeping for Family and FriendsOn the first floor, two inviting bedrooms offer flexible accommodations, with one featuring a double bed and the other a twin, complemented by a conveniently located full bathroom. Upstairs, the open loft serves as a peaceful retreat with a luxurious king bed and access to a private porch with seating—an ideal spot for quiet mornings or unwinding beneath the evening sky.Effortless Coastal LivingThoughtful conveniences elevate your stay, including a stackable washer and dryer, an outdoor shower perfect for rinsing off after the beach, and a charcoal grill just off the front porch for laid-back cookouts in the coastal breeze.Your Seaside Escape AwaitsWith its charming design, thoughtful updates, and tucked-away location, Mis B’ Haven offers a truly special way to experience Seaside—where peaceful moments, family memories, and timeless coastal charm come together effortlessly.* 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break; 5-night minimum Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES732 square feet of charming coastal living, located directly across from the beach266 feet of a 1 minute walk to beach access Private Seaside residential beach access at Tupelo Pavilion; largest private beaches on 30AOutdoor convenience: Enclosed outdoor shower, outdoor charcoal grill Seaside amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickle ball (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote includes: Two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes (pickup at the Seaside Transit Authority)Guest services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: Two parking passes are issued; golf carts are considered a vehicle and count toward parking limits; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; exceptions for medical or special circumstances require an approved permitNo pets permittedSTR23-001870
